== Old PC website (swccgpc.com) facts added, 24 November 2026 ==
New page, drafted from old Players Committee forum posts.

=== Sources used ===
* Players Committee forum topic 3644, "2004 Iowa SWCCG State Championship", posts 49785, 51759, 50169 (refs <code>pcf-3644-…</code>).

=== Missing data ===
* Full standings and decks.

=== Possibly faulty data ===
* On 24 July 2004 the announcement was quoted with the heading "2004 WI SWCCG State Championship"; Kolnik called it a copy-and-paste slip, and the captured post (last edited 26 August 2004) reads "IA".

=== Marginal cuts ===
* Kolnik's email addresses (privacy).

=== Build notes ===
* Environment line left out: [[Virtual Set 7: Shadows Of The Empire|Virtual Set 7]] was released on 16 July 2004 and its tournament-legal date is not known, so the pool for this date cannot be named from the sources. The [[List of SWCCG tournaments]] row gives [[Premiere - Original VS6]].
